claim: Youth-research firm reports Gen Z adoption of needlepoint, #Needlepoint at 119K TikTok videos, and beginner kits selling out at New York shops.
excerpt: Search summary: #Needlepoint 119K TikTok videos; 'analog hobbies' Google searches up 160% in the past month; NY shops' beginner kits selling out within days; one owner hit her eight-year sales projection in 'five' (unit differs between summaries; treat as unverified); home stitch nights and studios thriving as third spaces.
title: Needlepoint is the latest granny hobby Gen Z can't put down
